caption:
Your old dial scale is basically a guessing game.

Dial scales have a needle that swings past the number you're trying to read, and the glass fogs or shifts after years of use. Most people just round to the nearest five pounds and call it good.

This is a digital bathroom scale, so instead of squinting at a needle you get a number straight on the display. It's rated 4.7 stars across more than three hundred thousand reviews.

You get a clear readout each time you step on, no guessing involved, and it runs about $17.
